title: Full-Stack Developer
description: Built a full-stack web application in 3 days that helps Moroccan families track children's vaccination schedules with AI-powered voice reminders. Features an admin dashboard for health officials to monitor regional vaccination coverage across Morocco.
responsibilities: Developed full-stack application using React 19, TypeScript, and FastAPI with PostgreSQL.
Integrated ElevenLabs API for AI-generated Arabic voice reminders.
Implemented Twilio for automated phone calls and SMS notifications.
Built multi-lingual support (Arabic RTL, French, English) using i18next.
Created admin dashboard with interactive Morocco map and regional analytics using Leaflet and Recharts.
Deployed frontend on Vercel and backend on Render.
